noBase: not enough history for a baseline
unavailable: Not available: 5/15/30 min blocks need a range of 10 days or less.
tooMany: Too many blocks for this range.
biggerThanRange: The block is larger than the range.
editOverviewHelp: Lists any device (even if not in the chart) that has been unusually active in the last two hours, and shows a red counter. Nothing is shown while all devices are normal.
editDevicesHelp: Up to 12. Leave empty to show the three busiest.
editInvalid: That block size is not available for this range; the card will use a larger one.
cardDescription: Per-device DNS activity with unusual-activity detection
cardLiveDescription: Live pulse of one device: rate, usual range, allowed and blocked queries
editAnimateHelp: Smooth gauge and ring movement. Off by default.
